findings.highlight: I’m not happy about just relying on Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバー一人に頼るのは申し訳ない
findings.governingReading: He feels sorry about having to rely on Saber alone.
findings.explanation: The English changes Shirou’s guilt toward Saber into dissatisfaction with the plan.

findings.highlight: You should be able to hold on for a few minutes with Rin and Illyasviel.
findings.evidenceJa: 凛とイリヤスフィールの力があれば、数分は持ち堪えられる
findings.governingReading: Rin and Illya’s combined strength should let them hold out for several minutes.
findings.explanation: The English addresses the estimate to Shirou as a participant even though Saber has just ordered him to return to Rin and Illya; it blurs who provides the defensive strength.

findings.highlight: we’re going to lock ourselves in here until Saber’s done
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は足手まといになるから、セイバーが決着をつけるまでここで篭城
findings.governingReading: Because he would hinder Saber, Shirou will hole up here until she settles the fight.
findings.explanation: The English changes Shirou’s explanation of his own assigned action into a newly announced collective plan.

findings.evidenceJa: ここを見張ってた竜牙兵たち
findings.governingReading: the dragon-tooth soldiers that had been watching this place
findings.explanation: The English removes the just-established creature class from Illya’s tactical report.
The repeated English again overstates Rin’s reading of Shirou’s unconvinced expression.
The alternate branch repeats the anatomical relocation of the Command Spell.

findings.highlight: I look at my left hand.
findings.governingReading: He looks at his left arm.
findings.explanation: The follow-up again relocates the mark from arm to hand.

findings.evidenceJa: 廊下から入ってきたセイバーは
findings.governingReading: Saber comes back from the corridor clutching her chest in distress.
findings.explanation: The repeated English again abandons the sentence after “and” and resumes with a subjectless duplicate entrance.

findings.highlight: My only concern is Saber in pain.
findings.evidenceJa: 傷ついたセイバーしか目に入らない
findings.governingReading: He can see nothing but the wounded Saber.
findings.explanation: The repeated line again turns perceptual tunnel vision into concern and weakens wounded to pain.

findings.highlight: I’m slashed from my left shoulder to the waist in a single blow.
findings.evidenceJa: 肩から下まで真っ二つにされた
findings.governingReading: He is split in two from the shoulder down in a single blow.
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats the unsupported left-shoulder-to-waist trajectory.

findings.highlight: The brilliant slash numbs the pain
findings.evidenceJa: 鮮やかな剣筋は痛みを遅らせ
findings.governingReading: The clean sword stroke delays the arrival of pain.
findings.explanation: The repeated English again changes delayed pain into numbed sensation.
